subject: Stakeholder map & mutual action plan for FinPay (next steps)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@finpay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:23:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Intro / discovery — stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Eleanor — great to meet today, thanks for the time. Quick recap + proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from today's call:
- Use case: FinPay wants to reduce per-transaction inference cost for fraud scoring while keeping P95 latency under 120ms for approval flows.
- Volume: ~2.5M transactions/day peak, avg 200M tokens/day across batch scoring and streaming inference.
- Musts: SOC 2, data residency in us-east, integration with KMS, and procurement/legal review.

Immediate asks / next steps:
1) Stakeholder map — can you confirm who needs to be involved for security/legal/procurement + the economic buyer? I sketched a map during the call but want names so we can assign MAP owners.
2) Share MAP (attached draft) — I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan with proposed milestones (security review, procurement, pilot dates). Please review and comment.
3) Security artifacts — we will send SOC2 summary and our pen test summary; can you share any questionnaire templates (or a Doc) we should complete?
4) Procurement timing — you mentioned an April business-go-live target. If procurement/contracting needs 4–6 weeks after security sign-off, we should define milestone dates now.
5) Next meeting — propose a 30-min alignment with Security + Procurement next Wed 2/18 at 11am PT. Does that work for your team?

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP draft), SOC2-summary.pdf (summary of controls)

Thanks — I"ll update the MAP after I get the stakeholder names.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0187

---
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference.
From: Eleanor Park <eleanor@finpay.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@finpay.com>, Procurement <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 12:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro / discovery — stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Thanks Marissa — big picture, this resonated with the team. Confirming stakeholder list below so you can update the MAP: 

- Economic buyer: Tom Brooks (SVP Product) — tom.brooks@finpay.com
- Security: Anita Singh (Head of Security) — anita.singh@finpay.com
- Legal: Claire Mendes (c.mendes@finpay.com)
- Procurement: procurement@finpay.com (lead: Marco Li)
- Engineering lead: Daniel Cho (d.cho@finpay.com)

Timeline: we are targeting an internal approval by end of March for a pilot in April. Procurement will need the security artifacts and a final quote.

On the MAP draft: I like the milestone structure. Two asks from our side: 
1) Add an explicit handoff milestone when Security completes a questionnaire so Procurement has a clear start date.
2) Add a short acceptance criteria section for the pilot (latency, throughput, data handling).

Wed 2/18 11am PT works for initial alignment — please send meeting invite with an agenda.

Best,
Eleanor
Director of Product, FinPay
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Eleanor Park <eleanor@finpay.com>, Tom Brooks <tom.brooks@finpay.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Intro / discovery — stakeholder map & MAP next steps

Thanks Eleanor — adding the people and your two asks. Updated plan below and attaching the MAP v1 with explicit Security handoff and pilot acceptance criteria.

Updated MAP highlights (attached Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx):
- Milestone A (Week of 2/16): Security kick-off — Redwood will provide SOC2 summary + questionnaire answers. Owner: Anita Singh / Marissa Cole.
- Milestone B (Week of 3/8): Security sign-off (questionnaire complete + evidence). Owner: Anita Singh.
- Milestone C (Week of 3/15): Procurement review starts — Procurement lead Marco Li.
- Milestone D (Week of 3/29): Contract signature (target).
- Milestone E (April): Pilot kick-off — acceptance criteria: P95 latency < 120ms, throughput 5k TPS sustained, KMS integration verified.

Planned deliverables from Redwood: SOC2-summary.pdf (attached), completed security questionnaire (if you share template), initial quote / SOW (we"ll send within 48h), and integration checklist for engineering.

I"ve sent a calendar invite for Wed 18 Feb 11:00 PT titled "FinPay — Security & Procurement alignment (Redwood)" with an agenda: 1) Quick intros, 2) Security artifacts & questionnaire ownership, 3) Procurement timeline & required docs, 4) Next MAP adjustments. Please let me know if you'd like additional attendees.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, SOC2-summary.pdf

Thanks — Marissa
